handback.t:
MESH-2 (D2) done. I added an opt-in `HierSecondOpinion` gate. It cuts the no-harm cost by about 65-75% but does not remove it. It matches the old SecondOpinion where verifiers exist. It does not beat it there, and it does not meet the strict "no Holm loss in none/weak worlds" bar.

**What I built**
- `HierSecondOpinion` and `HierSoConfig` are appended to `src/variants.rs`. Existing `SecondOpinion` is untouched. Config is `#[serde(default)]`, and I added 2 tests (`hier_so_tests`).
- Shrinkage runs global (all checkers) -> checker -> (feature, checker) cell. Optimism is applied at the checker level, so exploration stops once pooled evidence is conclusive. If no checker ever catches anything, the gate switches itself off.
- The optional agent-pooled leader prior and the cell-level optimism were not selected by tuning. `probe_every` defaults to 0 and was not tested in the lab.
- The lab is `src/bin/d2_lab.rs`. It reuses the x2_lab world and wraps warm(hebbian-robust). Tuning is on seeds 1-8 with a regret-averse objective, held-out is 31-60, and the confirmation run on 61-90 reuses the same frozen tuning.
- Holm correction is applied over 72 tests per run.
- Results are in `results/d2_lab.json`, `results/d2_lab_confirm61-90.json` and their `.log` files, plus `results/d2_lab_grid1.log`. The board entry is appended to `results/research_board.md`.
- `cargo test --release --lib`: 178 passed, 0 failed.

**Rerun command** (about 2.3 min, deterministic)
```
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/c/Users/mariu/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WinGet/Packages/BrechtSanders.WinLibs.POSIX.UCRT_Microsoft.Winget.Source_8wekyb3d8bbwe/mingw64/bin:$PATH"; export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=C:/Users/mariu/nm-target-r2; cd /c/Users/mariu/neural-mesh && cargo run --release --bin d2_lab -- --out results/d2_lab.json
```
For confirmation, add `--held 61-90 --out results/d2_lab_confirm61-90.json`.

**Results (held-out 31-60; 61-90 numbers agree)**

| Item | Hier | Old SecondOpinion | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| none-worlds, net@0.05 vs bare warm | -0.0005 [-0.0005,-0.0004] | -0.0019 | calls/task 1.010 vs 1.038 |
| none-worlds, net@0.10 vs bare warm | -0.0004 | -0.0012 | calls/task 1.004 vs 1.012 |
| hier vs old, none-worlds | +0.0014 @0.05, +0.0008 @0.10 | | 30/30 seeds, Holm p<1e-4 |
| v-fixed, net@0.05 vs best fair | +0.0121 [+.0090,+.0152] | | 30/30, Holm p<1e-4 (61-90: +0.0113) |
| v-random, net@0.05 vs best fair | +0.0111 [+.0072,+.0150] | | Holm p=1e-4 (61-90: +0.0109) |
| v-fixed, net@0.10 vs best fair | +0.0042 | | Holm p=.002 |
| v-random, net@0.10 vs best fair | +0.0036 | | Holm p=.0075 |
| hier vs old, verifier worlds | | | n.s., within ±0.002 |

- **Learning speed (a):** in none-worlds, hier is +0.008 net@0.05 better than old at H250 and +0.004 at H500 (30/30). With real verifiers it is not faster than old (n.s.).
- **v-weak (c=0.10):** hier beats old by +0.0005 [+.0003,+.0008], Holm p=.003 (61-90: +0.0007). At c=0.05 it ties old at full horizon.

**Negatives**
- Hier does not improve net over old SecondOpinion where verifiers exist.
- Tiny Holm-significant losses vs bare warm remain: -0.0003 to -0.0005 in none-worlds, and -0.0005 in v-weak at net@0.10. These come from about 20 exploratory checks per run.
- v-notraps net@0.10 vs keyword is still Holm-worse (-0.0096 on 31-60, -0.0100 on 61-90). It is not fixed, and the weakness is the warm router, not the gate.
- The worlds are author-built.
- Protocol disclosure: I widened the `pool_global` grid from {4,32} to {8,32,128} on seeds 1-8 after seeing the first held-out run. That raised the c=0.10 config from -0.0017 to ties-old vs old SecondOpinion in v-fixed. The 61-90 confirmation was run after that single revision.
